sections.title: Crew shapes and form rules
sections.what: Describes the crew summary, member and detail shapes sent to the browser. Also sets the crew name rule (2 to 40 characters) and the invite code rule (six letters or digits).
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps screen and server data in one agreed form.

summary: Defines crew data shapes and the form rules for crew names and invite codes.
purpose: Shared crew shapes and input checks.
why: Likely reason: one definition for the screens and the server.
how: 1. Define the summary, member and detail shapes. 2. Set the crew name rule (2 to 40 characters). 3. Set the invite code rule (six letters or digits, changed to capitals).
risks: The code rule allows letters such as O and I that the generator never makes. Such codes simply match nothing.
debug: If a valid code is refused, check the trimming, capitals and length.
